notes: Backend scheduler runtime. UI is outside the contract. run_due advances next_run_at but tests prove it does not execute the action. Dispatch/execute remains ABSENT, not a reason to drop dispatch from the frozen contract.

semantic_contract.user_intent: When a schedule is due, deterministically dispatch a durable run and advance recurrence.
semantic_contract.preconditions: Enabled schedule with a computable next_run_at; company scope.
semantic_contract.input: cron/every spec, timezone, action kind, due watermark
semantic_contract.state_transition: scheduled → due → dispatched run → next_run advanced
semantic_contract.output: durable run record and new next_run_at
semantic_contract.visibility_access_semantics: company operator / runtime; not end-user CMS
semantic_contract.failure_semantics: invalid cron fail-closed; agent approval-blocked; missing db 503
semantic_contract.external_effect_requirement: dispatch of the scheduled action (workflow/runtime effect)
semantic_contract.money_impact: none unless the scheduled action is money; this capability itself is not money
semantic_contract.user_observable_outcome: next_run_at advances; a durable run exists
semantic_contract.no_ai_behavior: deterministic cron/due math; AI not required
semantic_contract.donor_semantics: Chronica legacy routine-cron: cadence floor, catch-up, fire-at-most-once
semantic_contract.chronica_allowed_divergences: action execution may be a separate worker; due-advance is still required
